text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, into the final stretch! A burst of 
speed toward Derby glory!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Let's settle this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd let you!! Not in this Derby, 
absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't yield, I won't yield!! I'm going 
to win for Maruzen-san's sake too!

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!! Yaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...The shadow of defeat. An overwhelming 
force swallowing me whole――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if my legs shatter into 
pieces!! I will burn up this very life and 
carve proof that I existed right here and 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, nooo!! *I'm* going to win the 
Derby! Meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(............No! As if I'd lose! Like hell 
I'll go down hereeee!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I... I wiiiiiill... Aaaaagh, I willlll!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm the strongest of allllll! 
Oraaaaaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She broke clear, she broke clear! Crossing 
the finish line in the lead! This year's 
Derby Umamusume is—...
(Woooooaaaaahhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Ah, my heart is still 
trembling...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Chiyo-chan. Everyone. That 
was a magnificent Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... *gasp*, ugh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I lost... Maruzen-san and my Derby 
is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Uuu... *sob* Waaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ......Back then, I... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's intensity was incredible! 
It gave me total chills!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a race!! I could feel our souls 
clashing out there!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: !? ...R-Really...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That was an unforgettable, legendary 
showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …………Ngh! Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san, Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I would like to express my gratitude to 
both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Gratitude, to us...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The only reason I could run like I did 
today is because I was pulled forward by 
the sheer passion of you both.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to lose to that sheer 
tenacity... I wanted to burn my soul and 
shine brightly, just like the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You are saying... that we were shining?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —That is how it appeared to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A desire to seize victory even at the cost 
of everything. That sheer obsession made 
both of their lives shine brightly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was utterly captivated by the way both 
of you ran.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! ...Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Though I was unable to leave behind great 
achievements, I was at least able to 
engrave proof that I lived..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is seared into my heart, vivid and 
dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I hope Maruzen-san feels the same 
way..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: With that smile, surely.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san, Ardan-san. Thank you both 
for your burning determination.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I... thank you very much as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Still! I'll win next time!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Without fail, victory shall be mine!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I won't back down either!!

They exchanged refreshing smiles and shook 
hands. However, in stark contrast to that 
friendly air—

Upon returning to the waiting room, Yaeno 
Muteki wore a solemn expression. She was 
smiling out on the turf, so what could be 
the matter?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I was reflecting on my blunder. It is a 
grave issue that cannot simply be 
overlooked.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In the final stretch of the race... I 
surrendered myself to pure passion and ran 
purely on competitive spite.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was nearly overwhelmed and swallowed up 
by the roaring spirits of Chiyono O-san 
and Ardan-san—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……I felt that I was going to lose.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yet in the next instant, my inner passion 
cried out. Refusing to lose. Telling me to 
bite down and hold on!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The blood boiled throughout my entire 
body, and I snapped. I couldn't stop my 
sprinting legs.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I must have been on the verge of 
running out of control.
choice_data_list:
Still, that's exactly why it was such a 
great match.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am satisfied with today's race as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was able to have a wonderful showdown 
with Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san. And I 
believe I gave the best run I possibly 
could.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It was the best I could do right now, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't cast off my restraints, I 
never would have been able to challenge 
the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I cannot overlook my own inadequacy and 
immaturity that caused this.
choice_data_list:
Sometimes it comes down to a clash of 
fighting spirit at the very end.

text_block_list.text:
When racers are evenly matched and neck 
and neck, it's often the one with the 
stronger fighting spirit who prevails.

"Today's race was precisely that kind of 
situation. I reassure her that there's no 
reason to be pessimistic."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However... if placed in the same situation 
again, the possibility of her losing 
control in the future is not zero.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"To accept such an unstable running style 
and see it through to the end is..."
choice_data_list:
Then let's further master "Fire and Water 
as One."

text_block_list.text:
Elevate the level of both running and 
tactics. Doing so should reduce the 
situations where you cannot win without 
removing your restraints.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —I agree. I'm also in favor of that plan.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... I am relieved to hear 
that you share the same view, 
Trainer-dono."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please guide me well so that I can run 
consistently at the Kikuka Sho.

The final race of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Kikuka-sho. In all likelihood, 
Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan will be 
running as well.
choice_data_list:
Looks like we're in for another tough 
battle.

Looks like we're in for another tough 
battle, huh.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, I am looking forward to it 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Because with you and the others, Chiyono 
O-san, we can strive for a battle that 
surpasses even today's.

Reaching even greater heights with them at 
the Kikuka Sho. Yaeno Muteki's smile spoke 
volumes.
However, a few days later—

Word arrived that both Sakura Chiyono O 
and Mejiro Ardan would be sitting out of 
races for a while due to injuries.
